dct_description_sm: Supplementary dataset containing preliminary experiments conducted during the development of the compost-bedded pack (CBP) model system. The data include evaluations of sawdust application rates and pack container insulation designs used to optimize environmental conditions and improve the representation of CBP systems prior to implementation of the main study.
dct_title_s: Supplementary file: Development of a controlled laboratory model for studying compost bedded pack systems and microbial dynamics
